build_gaussian_kernel: build a JIT-compiled Gaussian kernel function that computes normalized Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
create_polynomial_envelope: create a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent to apply smooth cutoff to scaled distance tensors
build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module that embeds distance values into a fixed number of Gaussian basis functions
create_radial_mlp: create a RadialMLP module that constructs a radial function from linear layers, layer normalization, and SiLU activations
test_radial_mlp_forward: test the RadialMLP forward pass by passing input tensors through the sequential network and verifying output shape
